name: agentproto-plugin
description: Operate and supervise a fleet of coding agents (claude-code, hermes, codex, ...) through the agentproto daemon: launch and babysit agent sessions, run them in parallel, drive economical light models with a Sonnet verification net, orchestrate an orchestrator (nested), govern durable supervision (policies, gated commits, webhook escalation), set up adapters and tunnels, use custom LLM endpoints, and author protocol tools/drivers.
